text: MindIE Agent for DeepSeek Harness 是面向昇腾 NPU 工作流的 DSH 插件，通过 Host 组合接入领域知识工具、远程开发工具和本地 MindIE 组件。用户可在会话中检索并解释知识条目、沉淀已验证经验、刷新知识源，也可调用远端开发以及 Ascend profiler、仿真和协调器工具。知识操作通过 DSH 会话工具进入本地运行时，组件工具则由 MCP 桥接提供。适合使用 DSH 开发、测试和调优昇腾 NPU 软件的工程师。需要配置本地 MindIE 运行时；插件更新检查会查询 GitHub Releases。

--- **MindIE Agent for DeepSeek Harness**（`mindie-agent-dsh`）是 [MindIE Agent](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent) 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的原生插件适配器，当前正式版本为 `0.1.16`（配套主产品 `0.1.12`）。
mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：它面向昇腾（Ascend）NPU AI Infra 设计、开发与测试全流程，当前 `0.1.16` 已交付 **`vLLM-Ascend` 特性开发与测试**、**`AscendC` / `Triton` 算子实现验证**等能力（更多昇腾基础软件方向按路线图持续扩展）：

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：- **`/mindie-agent` 领域知识、Skill 与经验沉淀入口**：按需调用 `mindie_entry`、`knowledge_query`、`knowledge_explain`、`knowledge_distill`、`knowledge_feedback`、`knowledge_sync`，检索 `knowledge-vllm-ascend` 工程案例，并按 `L1`/`L2` 基础基线、`L3` Hermes 收敛与 `L4` RSI 去偏探索推进任务；开启贡献时自动完成 `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 公开对话脱敏采集与社区 PR 发布；
- **远端开发与本地组件工具**：`remote-dev` 负责远端文件读写、命令执行与后台任务管理；`mindie-tools` 提供本地诊断、状态查询，以及 `profiler`、`sim`、`coordinator` 的调用入口。两组工具默认可用；
- **生态支持**：当前 `v0.1.16`（配套主产品 `0.1.12`）同步支持 Claude Code（[`mindie-agent-cc`](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent-cc)）、OpenAI Codex CLI（[`mindie-agent-codex`](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent-codex)）、Kimi Code（[`mindie-agent-kimi`](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent-kimi)）、Google Antigravity（[`mindie-agent-agy`](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent-agy)）与 DeepSeek Harness（本仓库）。

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：项目遵循 [MindIE Agent 工程设计原则](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent/blob/main/docs/design-principles.md) 的薄适配层架构：本仓库专注于 DSH Host 组合、会话采集与本地代数切换，而多领域分层路由、分片索引、`L1–L4` 分级知识单元校验与社区发布门禁均由共享组件 [`mindie-knowledge`](https://github.com/mindie-agent/knowledge) 统一承载。

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：> [!IMPORTANT]
> **稳定性设计：只依赖 DSH 标准发行版中的稳定插件。**
> 本适配器仅组合 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 两个非 experimental 包与本地 Host 入口 `./host.mjs`，**不引入任何 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-*`**，**不覆盖任何 DSH 内置行或内置预设**。
> 新增的两条 Host 行（`mindie-agent-skill`、`mindie-agent-host`，其中 `host.mjs` 在同一子纤维 `mindie-agent-generation` 中同代挂载 `./host3.mjs` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`）均挂载在 Host 层，因此 **`standard` 标准预设及其它预设会直接继承**，无需切换专门模式。

mindie-agent-dsh README · `mindie-tools` 本地诊断与分析组件服务（`scripts/component_mcp.py`）：相对路径默认按当前会话的工作目录解析，也可用绝对路径 `cwd` 指定其他目录。`argv` 直接传给组件，不经过 shell 展开。若可选组件未安装，调用会返回明确提示；本地与 CI 测试通过 `component-contracts` 依赖组安装对应版本。

单次调用超时默认 120 秒（`timeout_ms=120000`）、最多可设 10 分钟（`600000`）；输出默认最多 64 KiB（`max_output_tokens=16384`）、最多可设 1 MiB（`262144`），两路输出合计按每 token 4 字节计，大报告建议保存到文件。

- **不覆盖**任何 DSH 内置行或预设，仅通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 执行 `insert`；DSH 标准预设改动不会被本适配器遮蔽。
- `package.json` 仅声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <1.0.0`）可选 peer 依赖，安装时不会把第二个 DSH 运行时拉入 profile。

mindie-agent-dsh README · 贡献与故障上报：- **统一持久化贡献开关（`mindie-consent.json`）**：社区知识共享与工具故障自动上报共用同一个持久化开关。显式选择 `contribute` 会配置项目范围内的公开知识共享（默认上游 `mindie-agent/knowledge-vllm-ascend`，自动解析或创建个人 Fork）并启动原生后台故障上报 worker；选择 `disabled` 则同时停止两者的后续外发。
- **升级保持与旧版授权重确认**：已有的 `disabled`、`later`、`read-only` 选择在升级后保持关闭。旧版仅含知识共享授权（缺少统一授权 `choice_revision` / 标记为 `needs_choice`）的记录在升级或常规启动时**不会**自动获得故障上传权限，必须由用户显式重新确认一次后才允许上传故障报告。
- **三态严格区分**：系统严格区分（1）本地授权配置已写入 `mindie-consent.json`、（2）后台上报/整理 worker 正在运行、（3）外部 GitHub Issue 或知识 PR 已实际创建。可通过 `reporting-status` 只读查看 worker 与队列真实状态，详见 **[用户须知](skills/mindie-agent/references/user-notice.md)**。

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：**MindIE Agent for DeepSeek Harness** (`mindie-agent-dsh`) is the native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) adapter for [MindIE Agent](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent), release `0.1.16` (paired with `mindie-agent 0.1.12`).

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：Designed for the Ascend NPU AI Infra design, development, and testing lifecycle, `0.1.14` delivers **`vLLM-Ascend` feature development & testing** and **`AscendC` / `Triton` operator implementation & verification** (with broader Ascend AI Infra domains expanding on the roadmap):

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：Following the [MindIE Agent Engineering Design Principles](https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent/blob/main/docs/design-principles.en.md), this repository acts as a thin host adapter for DSH composition, transcript capture, and local generation updates, while domain routing rules, shard indexing, `L1–L4` graded knowledge unit validation, and publication gates are handled by the shared [`mindie-knowledge`](https://github.com/mindie-agent/knowledge) engine.

mindie-agent-dsh README · Introduction：> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Stability by composition: stable DSH plugins only.**
> This adapter composes `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, and the local Host plugin `./host.mjs`. It uses **no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-*` package**, overrides **no shipped row or shipped preset**, and inserts its two Host rows (`mindie-agent-skill` and `mindie-agent-host`, where `host.mjs` co-generationally mounts `./host3.mjs` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` inside the `mindie-agent-generation` child fiber) at the Host layer so the shipped `standard` preset and other presets inherit them directly.

mindie-agent-dsh README · Quick Start：> **Plugin Marketplace Discovery**: This repository carries the GitHub topic [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) for automatic indexing in DSH plugin marketplaces.

```text
Please install https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent-dsh for me
```

mindie-agent-dsh README · `mindie-tools` Local Diagnostics & Analysis MCP Server (`scripts/component_mcp.py`)：Relative paths resolve against the current session working directory; use an absolute `cwd` to select another directory. `argv` is passed directly to the component without shell expansion. mindie-agent-dsh README · `mindie-tools` Local Diagnostics & Analysis MCP Server (`scripts/component_mcp.py`)：- **No override** of any shipped row or preset — `cordis.patch.yml` only performs `insert` operations, so DSH upgrades to the standard preset are never shadowed.
- The package declares only an optional peer on `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (`>=0.2.0-rc.2 <1.0.0`), avoiding duplicate DSH runtimes in the profile.

mindie-agent-dsh README · Contribution and Fault Reporting：- **Unified Persistent Switch (`mindie-consent.json`)**: Community knowledge sharing and automatic tool fault reporting share a single persistent switch. Explicitly selecting `contribute` configures scoped public knowledge sharing (defaulting to `mindie-agent/knowledge-vllm-ascend` with automatic personal fork resolution) and starts the native background fault reporter; selecting `disabled` stops subsequent outgoing sends for both paths.
- **Upgrade Preservation & Legacy Re-Confirmation**: Existing `disabled`, `later`, and `read-only` choices stay off across upgrades. Legacy knowledge-only `contribute` records lacking the unified consent revision (`choice_revision` / marked `needs_choice`) do **not** automatically gain fault-upload permission on upgrade or startup until explicitly re-confirmed once by the user.
- **Three-State Separation**: The system strictly separates (1) local consent configuration written to `mindie-consent.json`, (2) background reporter or organizer worker running, and (3) external GitHub Issue or knowledge PR created.
